description: A public reconstruction of the spatial comment-reading case used during the Flash-Next qualification.
prompt: Read the screenshot spatially. Transcribe the author and main claim of the topmost visible comment, then separately transcribe the author and main claim of the bottommost visible comment. For the top comment, also state its claimed context length, decode speed, and serving stack. Do not mix the two comments.

comments.author: Turbulent-Alps4046
comments.text: Why quantize the KV cache? I get 512k context and 100+ tps decode on one RTX Pro Max Q without quantizing KV, using sglang + dflash2.
